[SWS_DM_CONSTR_00395] Restriction on DEM-exclusive Diagnos- ticDataElements
⌈
A DiagnosticParameter containing a DEM-exclusive in-
ternal DiagnosticDataElement shall not be contained in a Diagnostic-
DataIdentifier referenced by a DiagnosticReadDataByIdentifier, nor shall
it be contained in a realization of DiagnosticRoutineSubfunction.
